product_overview: UIU HealthCare is a digital healthcare platform for Bangladesh that unifies patient registration, appointment booking, verified doctor discovery, and secure medical record management. The product is designed to streamline healthcare access while supporting future expansion into AI assistance, telemedicine, wellness, and emergency services.
core_goals: Enable secure role-based registration and login for healthcare users
Allow patients to discover verified doctors and manage appointments
Provide secure electronic health record upload and retrieval
Support authenticated health record access for patients and care providers
Deliver a clean API foundation for future healthcare modules in the platform

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Allows new users to register and existing users to log in with email and password validation.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/register with valid patient details -> Receive 201 User created -> POST /api/auth/login with registered credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token
POST /api/auth/register with an email that already exists -> Receive 400 User already exists -> POST /api/auth/login with the same email and password -> Receive 200 with JWT token
POST /api/auth/login with invalid credentials -> Receive 400 Invalid credentials

features.name: Appointments
features.description: Supports booking, listing, and canceling patient appointments with authenticated access.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> POST /api/appointments with token and appointment details -> Receive 201 Appointment details -> GET /api/appointments/user/:userId with token -> Receive 200 Appointment[]

POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> DELETE /api/appointments/:id with token for an existing appointment -> Receive 200 Cancel confirmation -> GET /api/appointments/user/:userId with token -> Receive 200 updated Appointment[]
POST /api/appointments without a valid JWT token -> Receive an authorization failure due to auth_required=true
DELETE /api/appointments/:id with a non-existent appointment id -> Receive an error response and no cancellation confirmation

features.name: Health Records
features.description: Enables authenticated users to upload medical documents and retrieve patient health record lists.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> POST /api/records with token and a valid medical file -> Receive 201 Upload confirmation -> GET /api/records/:userId with token -> Receive 200 HealthRecord[]
POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> GET /api/records/:userId with token for a patient -> Receive 200 HealthRecord[]
POST /api/records without a valid JWT token -> Receive an authorization failure due to auth_required=true
POST /api/records with an unsupported or invalid file payload -> Receive an error response instead of upload confirmation

features.name: Doctors
features.description: Provides a public directory of verified doctors for patients to browse before booking appointments.
user_flows: GET /api/doctors when the doctor directory is unavailable -> Receive an error response and no doctor list is returned

endpoints.description: Register a new patient or user
List all appointments for a user
